app.title: MD Pencil
app.subtitle: Convert text from images and PDFs into clean Markdown documents.
app.description: Upload a file or paste an image to extract text via OCR and organize it into neat Markdown. Edit, copy, download, and listen — all in one place.

upload.dragDrop: Drag and drop a file here
upload.paste: You can also paste an image from clipboard (Ctrl+V)
upload.supported: Supported formats: JPG, PNG, WEBP, PDF

help.title: How to Use
help.section1Body: MD Pencil is a tool that extracts text from images or PDF files and organizes it into Markdown format. Easily convert worksheets, notices, scripts, and reading materials into digital documents.
help.step1: Upload an image (JPG, PNG, WEBP) or PDF file, or paste an image from your clipboard.
help.step2: OCR will automatically extract and organize the text into Markdown.
help.step4: Use the copy, download, or text-to-speech buttons to work with the results.
help.section3Body: Markdown is a simple way to format text using special characters. It's easy to learn!
help.section4Body: Listen to the result text using your browser's speech feature. You can play, pause, stop, and adjust speed. Markdown symbols (#, -, etc.) are automatically removed for natural reading.
